opportunities.title: Deck Cadet / Trainee Navigating Officer
opportunities.experienceRequired: Pre-sea Nautical Science completed / Fresher with valid CDC
opportunities.description: Recruitment intake for trainee navigating officers. Candidates will undergo structured onboard bridge watchkeeping training and vessel operations under senior navigational officers.
responsibilities: Assist the Officer of the Watch (OOW) in safe navigational watchkeeping and lookout duties.
Participate in deck maintenance, mooring operations, and cargo loading/discharge monitoring.
Maintain shipboard safety gear, lifesaving appliances, and firefighting apparatus under supervision.
Log daily training tasks in the official Training Record Book (TRB).
requirements: Completion of DG-approved Pre-sea Nautical Science program or equivalent diploma.
Continuous Discharge Certificate (CDC) and valid Indian/International Passport.
Valid STCW-2010 Basic Safety Training certificates.
DG-approved medical fitness certificate with normal color vision.

opportunities.title: Cruise Ship Hospitality & Guest Services Associate
opportunities.experienceRequired: 1-2 years in luxury hospitality, resort, or airline passenger handling
opportunities.description: Seeking polished guest service professionals for international passenger cruise vessels. Primary responsibilities include front-desk guest relations, itinerary briefings, and passenger satisfaction.
responsibilities: Handle guest check-in, embarkation, and debarkation procedures with high efficiency.
Address passenger queries, coordinate excursions, and resolve guest service requests.
Maintain adherence to international maritime hotel and public health (USPH/BPH) compliance standards.
Coordinate with shipboard safety crew during mandatory passenger muster drills.
requirements: Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, or International Tourism.
Fluent verbal and written English communication skills; additional European language is advantageous.
Valid international passport with at least 18 months validity.
Willingness to obtain STCW passenger ship crowd management certification upon selection.

opportunities.title: Marine Electro-Technical Officer (ETO)
opportunities.experienceRequired: Minimum 12 months seatime in rank on commercial tankers
opportunities.description: Experienced ETO required for fleet tankers with advanced automated engine rooms, cargo monitoring instrumentation, electrical power generation, and DP systems.
responsibilities: Maintain high-voltage/low-voltage distribution systems, switchboards, and emergency generators.
Troubleshoot electronic control systems, PLC automation, fire detection loops, and bridge electronics.
Supervise refrigeration plants, HVAC equipment, and alarm monitoring consoles.
Maintain electrical inventory, spare parts manifest, and compliance logs.
requirements: Certificate of Competency (CoC) as Electro-Technical Officer (ETO) under STCW standards.
Documented sea-service experience on tankers with automated power management systems.
Advanced High Voltage and Tanker Familiarization endorsements.

opportunities.title: Shipboard Wellness & Spa Therapist
opportunities.experienceRequired: Recognized spa therapist certification with 1+ years spa resort experience
opportunities.description: Join premier ocean fleet wellness centers delivering bespoke massage therapy, body treatments, and consultation services to international cruise travelers.
responsibilities: Deliver premium wellness therapies and treatment regimens according to brand specifications.
Conduct passenger wellness consultations and promote specialized retail therapies.
Ensure strict spa sanitization and maritime public health hygiene protocols.
Participate actively in onboard emergency safety drills and muster assignments.
requirements: Accredited certification in massage therapy, physiotherapy, or aesthetic spa care.
Warm professional demeanor with excellent customer engagement standards.
Valid passport with international travel clearance.

trainingPrograms.title: General Purpose (GP) Rating Pre-Sea Training
trainingPrograms.eligibility: 10th Standard pass with minimum 40% aggregate and 40% in English. Age between 17.5 to 25 years. Medically fit per maritime standards.
trainingPrograms.batchSchedule: Upcoming Offline Batches: January & July Intakes
trainingPrograms.overview: Comprehensive pre-sea training program preparing trainees for dual-purpose ratings onboard merchant vessels, covering both seamanship navigation deck duties and marine engine room maintenance.
curriculum: Bridge navigation watchkeeping, lookout duties & compass handling
Shipboard deck maintenance, mooring procedures, and rope work
Marine diesel engine fundamentals, auxiliary machinery, and workshop practice
STCW Mandatory Basic Safety Training (BST) & Security Familiarization
Physical endurance, swimming practicals, and maritime discipline
trainingPrograms.careerOutcome: Qualifies candidates to apply for Continuous Discharge Certificate (CDC) as Deck/Engine Trainee Rating on ocean-going vessels.
trainingPrograms.certificationBody: Approved Directorate General of Shipping Curriculum Standards

trainingPrograms.title: Diploma in Nautical Science (DNS) - Leading to B.Sc.
trainingPrograms.duration: 1 Year (Pre-Sea Residential Academy) + 18 Months Onboard Cadetship
trainingPrograms.eligibility: 10+2 (PCM) with minimum 60% aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and 50% in English. Age limit under 25 years.
trainingPrograms.batchSchedule: Biannual Offline Academy Sessions: February & August Batches
trainingPrograms.overview: Rigorous preparatory nautical curriculum qualifying aspiring cadets for merchant navy deck officer tracks, navigation theory, celestial navigation, electronic bridge simulators, and meteorology.
curriculum: Terrestrial & celestial navigation, ECDIS simulator drills, and passage planning
International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs)
Cargo handling, stowage calculations, and ship stability principles
Bridge Resource Management (BRM) & Marine Communications (GMDSS theory)
Maritime law, environmental protection (MARPOL) and safety protocols
trainingPrograms.careerOutcome: Leads to 2nd Mate (Foreign Going) Certificate of Competency after mandatory onboard sea-time training.
trainingPrograms.certificationBody: Maritime University & DG Shipping Standard Academic Framework

trainingPrograms.title: STCW Basic Safety Training (BST) Modular Package
trainingPrograms.eligibility: Minimum 18 years of age with passport or valid identity documentation and maritime medical clearance.
trainingPrograms.overview: Mandatory safety certification required for all seafarers embarking on merchant navy and commercial cruise ships worldwide under IMO/STCW conventions.
curriculum: Personal Survival Techniques (PST) with wet drill pool life raft deployment
Fire Prevention and Fire Fighting (FPFF) with live smoke chamber drills
Elementary First Aid (EFA) including CPR and trauma emergency response
Personal Safety and Social Responsibilities (PSSR) shipboard protocols
Security Awareness Training for Seafarers with Designated Security Duties
trainingPrograms.careerOutcome: Issuance of mandatory STCW-2010 safety course certificates essential for CDC issuance and shipboard embarkation.

trainingPrograms.title: Pre-Sea Training for Electro-Technical Officers (ETO)
trainingPrograms.eligibility: Degree/Diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering with minimum 60% marks and approved medical clearance.
trainingPrograms.overview: Specialized offline technical curriculum transforming electrical and electronics engineering graduates into marine ETO officers handling modern vessel automation, power distribution, and navigation systems.
curriculum: High-voltage marine power generation, switchgear, and synchronization
PLC-controlled automation, automation safety loops, and sensors
Bridge navigation electronics, radar, gyrocompass, and communication units
Refrigerated cargo plants, boiler controls, and marine propulsion management
trainingPrograms.careerOutcome: Prepares candidates for ETO oral examinations and cadetship placement on international automated merchant fleets.
trainingPrograms.certificationBody: DG Shipping Recognized Maritime Technical Guidelines
